blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Those criticizing President Marcos’ advice for the public to buy buckets and collect water ahead of Super El Niño should instead buy themselves “buckets and buckets of brains” to appreciate the President’s plan. This was according to Palace Press Officer Claire Castro at a briefing on Tuesday. Marcos, who was anticipating the negative impacts of Super El Niño, in a media interview in Singapore on Oct. 11, advised his countrymen to collect rainwater. “Bumili na kayo ng balde para ’pag umulan, makolekta na ninyo lahat (Buy pails now so that when it rains you can collect all [the […]...
